:::{#exm-linearity-expectation}
#### Expected total of two dice

Let $X$ and $Y$ be the results of two six-sided die rolls.
Each has expectation

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sumto{x}{6} x \cd \tfrac{1}{6} &= \tfrac{21}{6} \\
&= 3.5,
\end{aligned}
$$

so:

$$
\ba
\E{X + Y}
&= \E{X} + \E{Y}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation with } a = 1, b = 1, c = 0 \text{)}\\
&= 3.5 + 3.5
&& \text{(substitute)}\\
&= 7
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

This calculation does not need the rolls to be independent.

:::
